text.div:
English

Generated Narrative: ActorDefinition SpenserUnit

Actor: SpenserUnit Spenser UnitType: system

A single dispenser. As a server it accepts an order posted straight at it and dispenses on the spot, because posting to the device is itself the authorization to dispense. As a client it polls an Order Server, acts only on orders that have been made actionable, and reports back what it did.

See Interfaces.

name: SpenserUnit
title: Spenser Unit
description: A chocolate dispenser, acting as a FHIR server and a FHIR client at the same time.

extension.valueString: Um dispensador de chocolate, que atua como servidor FHIR e como cliente FHIR ao mesmo tempo.
Een chocoladedispenser die tegelijk als FHIR-server en als FHIR-client optreedt.
Un distributeur de chocolat, qui agit à la fois comme serveur FHIR et comme client FHIR.

documentation:
A single dispenser. As a **server** it accepts an order posted straight at it and dispenses on the spot, because posting to the device is itself the authorization to dispense. As a **client** it polls an Order Server, acts only on orders that have been made actionable, and reports back what it did.

See [Interfaces](interfaces.html).
